verses.1:1: In the beginning God created heaven and the earth.
verses.1:2: Now the earth was empty and vacant, and darkness was over the face of the abyss, and the Spirit of God was borne over the waters.
verses.1:3: And God said, "Let there be light." And light came to be.
verses.1:4: And God saw the light, that it was good; and He divided the light from the darkness.
verses.1:5: And He called the light Day, and the darkness Night. And evening and morning came to be, one day.
verses.1:6: God also said, "Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters, and let it divide waters from waters."
verses.1:7: And God made the expanse, and divided the waters that were under the expanse from those that were above the expanse. And it came to be so.
verses.1:8: And God called the expanse Heaven. And evening and morning came to be, the second day.
verses.1:9: Then God said, "Let the waters that are under heaven be gathered into one place, and let the dry land appear." And it came to be so.
verses.1:10: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gatherings of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:11: And He said, "Let the earth sprout green vegetation producing seed, and the fruit-bearing tree producing fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself upon the earth." And it came to be so.
verses.1:12: And the earth brought forth green vegetation bearing seed according to its kind, and the tree producing fruit, each having seed according to its species. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:13: And evening and morning came to be, the third day.
verses.1:14: Then God said, "Let there be light-bearers in the expanse of heaven to divide the day from the night, and let them serve for signs and seasons, and for days and years,
verses.1:15: so that they may shine in the expanse of heaven and give light to the earth." And it came to be so.
verses.1:16: And God made the two great light-bearers: the greater light-bearer to govern the day, and the lesser light-bearer to govern the night, and the stars.
verses.1:17: And He set them in the expanse of heaven to shine over the earth,
verses.1:18: and to govern the day and the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:19: And evening and morning came to be, the fourth day.
verses.1:20: God also said, "Let the waters bring forth creeping creatures with living soul, and flying creatures above the earth beneath the expanse of heaven."
verses.1:21: And God created the great sea creatures, and every living and moving soul that the waters had brought forth according to their species, and every flying creature according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:22: And He blessed them, saying, "Increase and multiply, and fill the waters of the sea, and let the birds multiply upon the earth."
verses.1:23: And evening and morning came to be, the fifth day.
verses.1:24: God also said, "Let the earth bring forth the living soul according to its kind: livestock, and creeping creatures, and wild beasts of the earth according to their species." And it came to be so.
verses.1:25: And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to their species, and the livestock, and every creeping creature of the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.1:26: And He said, "Let Us make man according to Our image and likeness, and let him rule over the fish of the sea, and the flying creatures of heaven, and the wild beasts, and the whole earth, and every creeping creature that moves upon the earth."
verses.1:27: And God created man according to His own image; according to the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
verses.1:28: And God blessed them and said, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it, and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and the flying creatures of heaven, and all living creatures that move upon the earth."
verses.1:29: And God said, "Look, I have given you every seed-bearing plant upon the earth, and all trees that have in themselves seed of their own kind, so that they may be food for you,
verses.1:30: and for all the animals of the earth, and for every bird of heaven, and for all things that move upon the earth and in which there is a living soul, so that they may have something to eat." And it came to be so.
verses.1:31: And God saw all the things that He had made, and they were very good. And evening and morning came to be, the sixth day.
verses.2:1: Therefore the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their adornment.
verses.2:2: And on the seventh day God finished His work that He had made, and He rested on the seventh day from all the work that He had accomplished.
verses.2:3: And He blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it He had ceased from all His work that God created to make.
verses.2:4: These are the generations of heaven and earth when they were created, in the day when the Lord God made heaven and earth,
verses.2:5: and every shrub of the field before it sprang up on the earth, and every plant of the region before it sprouted; for the Lord God had not caused rain upon the earth, and there was no man to till the earth.
verses.2:6: Instead, a spring rose up from the earth, watering the entire surface of the earth.
verses.2:7: Therefore the Lord God formed man from the clay of the earth, and breathed into his face the breath of life, and man became a living soul.
verses.2:8: Now the Lord God had planted a paradise of delight from the beginning, in which He placed the man whom He had formed.
verses.2:9: And the Lord God brought forth from the ground every tree beautiful to see and pleasant for eating, also the tree of life in the midst of paradise, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.2:10: And a river went out from the place of delight to water paradise, which from there divides into four heads.
verses.2:11: The name of the first is Pishon; it is the one that circles the whole land of Havilah, where gold comes forth.
verses.2:12: And the gold of that land is the finest; there also are found bdellium and onyx stone.
verses.2:13: And the name of the second river is Gihon; it is the one that circles the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.2:14: And the name of the third river is the Tigris; it goes toward the Assyrians. And the fourth river, it is the Euphrates.
verses.2:15: So the Lord God took the man and placed him in the paradise of delight, to work it and guard it.
verses.2:16: And He commanded him, saying, "From every tree of paradise you may eat;
verses.2:17: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you must not eat, for on whatever day you eat from it, you will surely die."
verses.2:18: The Lord God also said, "It is not good for the man to be alone; let Us make for him a helper like himself."
verses.2:19: Therefore, having formed from the ground all the animals of the earth and all the flying creatures of heaven, the Lord God brought them to Adam to see what he would call them; for whatever Adam called any living soul, that is its name.
verses.2:20: And Adam called by their names all the animals, and all the flying creatures of heaven, and all the wild beasts of the earth; yet for Adam there was not found a helper like him.
verses.2:21: So the Lord God cast a deep sleep upon Adam; and when he had fallen asleep, He took one of his ribs and filled up flesh in its place.
verses.2:22: And the Lord God built the rib that He had taken from Adam into a woman, and brought her to Adam.
verses.2:23: And Adam said, "This now is bone from my bones and flesh from my flesh; she will be called Woman, because she was taken from man."
verses.2:24: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and cling to his wife, and the two will be in one flesh.
verses.2:25: Now both of them were naked, namely Adam and his wife, and they were not ashamed.
verses.3:1: Now the serpent also was more cunning than all the animals of the earth that the Lord God had made. And it said to the woman, "Why has God commanded you not to eat from every tree of paradise?"
verses.3:2: The woman answered it, "From the fruit of the trees that are in paradise we eat;
verses.3:3: but from the fruit of the tree that is in the midst of paradise, God commanded us not to eat and not to touch it, so that we might not die."
verses.3:4: Then the serpent said to the woman, "By no means will you surely die.
verses.3:5: For God knows that on whatever day you eat from it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like gods, knowing good and evil."
verses.3:6: Therefore the woman saw that the tree was good for eating, and beautiful to the eyes, and delightful in appearance; and she took from its fruit and ate, and she gave to her husband, who ate.
verses.3:7: And the eyes of both of them were opened; and when they realized that they were naked, they sewed fig leaves together and made loincloths for themselves.
verses.3:8: And when they heard the voice of the Lord God walking about in paradise at the afternoon breeze, Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God in the midst of the trees of paradise.
verses.3:9: And the Lord God called Adam and said to him, "Where are you?"
verses.3:10: He said, "I heard Your voice in paradise, and I was afraid because I was naked, and I hid myself."
verses.3:11: He said to him, "Who then informed you that you were naked, unless you have eaten from the tree from which I had commanded you not to eat?"
verses.3:12: And Adam said, "The woman whom You gave as a companion to me, she gave me from the tree, and I ate."
verses.3:13: And the Lord God said to the woman, "Why have you done this?" She answered, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.3:14: And the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, you are cursed among all the animals and wild beasts of the earth. Upon your chest you will go, and earth you will eat all the days of your life.
verses.3:15: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed: she will crush your head, and you will lie in wait for her heel."
verses.3:16: To the woman also He said, "I will multiply your hardships and your conceptions; in pain you will bear children, and you will be under your husband's authority, and he will rule over you."
verses.3:17: And to Adam He said, "Because you listened to the voice of your wife and ate from the tree from which I had commanded you not to eat, cursed is the earth in your work; in toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.
verses.3:18: Thorns and thistles it will sprout for you, and you will eat the plants of the earth.
verses.3:19: In the sweat of your face you will eat bread until you return to the earth from which you were taken; because you are dust, and to dust you will return."
verses.3:20: And Adam called the name of his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all the living.
verses.3:21: The Lord God also made for Adam and his wife tunics of skin, and He clothed them.
verses.3:22: And He said, "Look, Adam has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil; now therefore, so that he might not stretch out his hand and also take from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever"—
verses.3:23: the Lord God sent him out from the paradise of delight to work the earth from which he was taken.
verses.3:24: And He drove Adam out, and placed before the paradise of delight the cherubim and a flaming, whirling sword to guard the way of the tree of life.
verses.4:1: Now Adam knew his wife Eve, who conceived and gave birth to Cain, saying, "I have acquired a man through God."
verses.4:2: And again she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel was a shepherd of sheep, and Cain a farmer.
verses.4:3: Now it happened after many days that Cain offered gifts to the Lord from the fruits of the earth.
verses.4:4: Abel also offered from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat; and the Lord showed regard for Abel and for his gifts.
verses.4:5: For Cain, however, and for his gifts He did not show regard; and Cain grew intensely angry, and his countenance fell.
verses.4:6: And the Lord said to him, "Why are you angry? And why has your face fallen?
verses.4:7: If you do well, will you not receive; yet if you do wrong, will sin not immediately be present at the door? But its desire will be under you, and you will rule over it."
verses.4:8: And Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let us go outside." And while they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.4:9: And the Lord said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" He answered, "I do not know. Am I my brother's guardian?"
verses.4:10: And He said to him, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the earth.
verses.4:11: Now therefore, you will be cursed upon the earth, which has opened its mouth and received your brother's blood from your hand.
verses.4:12: When you work it, it will not give you its fruits; you will be a wanderer and a fugitive upon the earth."
verses.4:13: And Cain said to the Lord, "My iniquity is too great for me to deserve pardon.
verses.4:14: Look, You are driving me out today from the face of the earth, and from Your face I will be hidden, and I will be a wanderer and a fugitive on the earth; therefore, everyone who finds me will kill me."
verses.4:15: And the Lord said to him, "By no means will it be so; rather, everyone who kills Cain will be punished sevenfold." And the Lord set a sign on Cain, so that anyone who found him would not kill him.
verses.4:16: And Cain went out from the face of the Lord and lived as a fugitive in the land toward the eastern region of Eden.
verses.4:17: Now Cain knew his wife, who conceived and gave birth to Enoch; and he built a city, and called its name after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.4:18: Moreover, Enoch fathered Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.
verses.4:19: He took two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other was Zillah.
verses.4:20: And Adah bore Jabal, who was the father of those living in tents and of shepherds.
verses.4:21: And his brother's name was Jubal; he himself was the father of those playing on the lyre and the pipe.
verses.4:22: Zillah also bore Tubal-cain, who was a hammerer and smith in all works of bronze and iron. Now the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.4:23: And Lamech said to his wives Adah and Zillah, "Hear my voice, wives of Lamech; listen closely to my speech: for I have killed a man for my wound, and a youth for my bruise.
verses.4:24: Sevenfold vengeance will be given for Cain, but for Lamech seventy times seven."
verses.4:25: Adam also knew his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and called his name Seth, saying, "God has appointed another seed for me instead of Abel, whom Cain killed."
verses.4:26: And to Seth also a son was born, whom he called Enosh; this one began to call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.5:1: This is the book of the generation of Adam. On the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.
verses.5:2: Male and female He created them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam on the day that they were created.
verses.5:3: Now Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and fathered one in his own image and likeness, and called his name Seth.
verses.5:4: And the days of Adam, after he fathered Seth, came to eight hundred years; and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:5: And all the time that Adam lived came to nine hundred thirty years, and he died.
verses.5:6: Seth also lived one hundred five years, and fathered Enosh.
verses.5:7: And Seth lived eight hundred seven years after he fathered Enosh, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:8: And all the days of Seth came to nine hundred twelve years, and he died.
verses.5:9: Now Enosh lived ninety years, and fathered Kenan.
verses.5:10: After his birth he lived eight hundred fifteen years, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:11: And all the days of Enosh came to nine hundred five years, and he died.
verses.5:12: Kenan also lived seventy years, and fathered Mahalalel.
verses.5:13: And Kenan lived eight hundred forty years after he fathered Mahalalel, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:14: And all the days of Kenan came to nine hundred ten years, and he died.
verses.5:15: Now Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and fathered Jared.
verses.5:16: And Mahalalel lived eight hundred thirty years after he fathered Jared, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:17: And all the days of Mahalalel came to eight hundred ninety-five years, and he died.
verses.5:18: And Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, and fathered Enoch.
verses.5:19: And Jared lived eight hundred years after he fathered Enoch, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:20: And all the days of Jared came to nine hundred sixty-two years, and he died.
verses.5:21: Moreover, Enoch lived sixty-five years, and fathered Methuselah.
verses.5:22: And Enoch walked with God; and he lived three hundred years after he fathered Methuselah, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:23: And all the days of Enoch came to three hundred sixty-five years.
verses.5:24: And he walked with God, and he was not seen, because God took him.
verses.5:25: Methuselah also lived one hundred eighty-seven years, and fathered Lamech.
verses.5:26: And Methuselah lived seven hundred eighty-two years after he fathered Lamech, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:27: And all the days of Methuselah came to nine hundred sixty-nine years, and he died.
verses.5:28: Now Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years and fathered a son.
verses.5:29: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one will comfort us from the works and toils of our hands on the earth which the Lord has cursed."
verses.5:30: And Lamech lived five hundred ninety-five years after he fathered Noah, and fathered sons and daughters.
verses.5:31: And all the days of Lamech came to seven hundred seventy-seven years, and he died. Now Noah, when he was five hundred years old, fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:1: And when men had begun to multiply on the earth and had brought forth daughters,
verses.6:2: the sons of God, seeing the daughters of men, that they were beautiful, took wives for themselves from all whom they had chosen.
verses.6:3: And God said, "My Spirit will not remain in man forever, because he is flesh; and his days will be one hundred twenty years."
verses.6:4: Now giants were on the earth in those days; for after the sons of God went in to the daughters of men and they gave birth, these are the mighty ones from ancient times, famous men.
verses.6:5: Now when God saw that the wickedness of men was great on the earth, and that every thought of the heart was intent on evil at all times,
verses.6:6: He regretted that He had made man on the earth. And touched inwardly with sorrow of heart,
verses.6:7: He said, "I will wipe out man, whom I have created, from the face of the earth, from man to animals, from the crawling creature to the birds of the sky; for I regret having made them."
verses.6:8: Noah, however, found grace before the Lord.
verses.6:9: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous and perfect man among his generations; he walked with God.
verses.6:10: And he fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.6:11: Now the earth was corrupt before God, and it was filled with iniquity.
verses.6:12: And when God had seen that the earth was corrupt (for all flesh had corrupted its way on the earth),
verses.6:13: He said to Noah, "The end of all flesh has come before Me; the earth is filled with iniquity because of them, and I will destroy them together with the earth.
verses.6:14: Make for yourself an ark of planed wood; you shall make small rooms in the ark, and you shall coat it with bitumen inside and outside.
verses.6:15: And this is how you shall make it: the length of the ark will be three hundred cubits, the width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.6:16: You shall make a window in the ark, and you shall finish the top to a cubit; and you shall place the door of the ark on the side; you shall make lower rooms, second-story chambers, and third stories in it.
verses.6:17: Look, I Myself will bring the waters of the flood upon the earth to kill all flesh in which is the spirit of life under heaven; everything that is on the earth will be consumed.
verses.6:18: And I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall enter the ark, you and your sons, your wife, and the wives of your sons with you.
verses.6:19: And of all living creatures of all flesh, you shall bring two of each into the ark, so that they may live with you: of the male sex and of the female.
verses.6:20: Of birds according to their kind, and of livestock in their kind, and of every crawling creature of the earth according to its kind: two of each from all of them will enter with you, so that they may be able to live.
verses.6:21: You shall therefore take with you of all foods that can be eaten, and you shall gather them to yourself; and they will be food both for you and for them."
verses.6:22: Therefore Noah did everything that God had commanded him.
verses.7:1: And the Lord said to him, "Enter the ark, you and all your household; for I have seen you to be righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.7:2: From all clean animals take seven and seven, male and female; but from the animals that are not clean, two and two, male and female.
verses.7:3: And also from the flying creatures of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, so that seed may be preserved on the face of the whole earth.
verses.7:4: For yet after seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights; and I will wipe out every substance that I have made from the surface of the earth."
verses.7:5: Therefore Noah did everything that the Lord had commanded him.
verses.7:6: And he was six hundred years old when the waters of the flood overflowed upon the earth.
verses.7:7: And Noah and his sons, his wife, and the wives of his sons entered the ark with him because of the waters of the flood.
verses.7:8: Also of the clean and unclean animals, and of the birds, and of everything that moves on the earth,
verses.7:9: two and two entered to Noah into the ark, male and female, just as the Lord had commanded Noah.
verses.7:10: And when the seven days had passed, the waters of the flood overflowed upon the earth.
verses.7:11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the springs of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of heaven were opened;
verses.7:12: and rain came upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.7:13: On that very day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth his sons, his wife, and the three wives of his sons with them entered into the ark:
verses.7:14: they themselves, and every animal according to its kind, and all livestock in their kind, and everything that moves on the earth in its kind, and every flying creature according to its kind, all birds, and all winged creatures,
verses.7:15: entered to Noah into the ark, two by two of all flesh in which there was the spirit of life.
verses.7:16: And those that entered went in male and female of all flesh, just as God had commanded him; and the Lord shut him in from the outside.
verses.7:17: And the flood continued for forty days on the earth; and the waters multiplied, and they lifted the ark high above the earth.
verses.7:18: They overflowed violently and filled everything on the surface of the earth; meanwhile, the ark was carried on the waters.
verses.7:19: And the waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.
verses.7:20: The water was fifteen cubits higher above the mountains that it had covered.
verses.7:21: And all flesh that moved on the earth was consumed: of birds, of animals, of beasts, and of all crawling creatures that crawl on the earth; all men,
verses.7:22: and all things in which there is the breath of life on the earth, died.
verses.7:23: And He wiped out every substance that was on the earth, from man to livestock, both the crawling creature and the birds of the sky; and they were wiped out from the earth. But Noah alone remained, and those who were with him in the ark.
verses.7:24: And the waters prevailed over the earth for one hundred fifty days.
verses.8:1: Now God remembered Noah, and all the living creatures, and all the livestock that were with him in the ark; He brought a wind over the earth, and the waters diminished.
verses.8:2: And the springs of the deep and the floodgates of heaven were closed, and the rains from heaven were restrained.
verses.8:3: And the waters turned back from the earth, going and returning; and they began to diminish after one hundred fifty days.
verses.8:4: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, on the mountains of Armenia.
verses.8:5: Meanwhile, the waters went on and decreased until the tenth month; for in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the peaks of the mountains appeared.
verses.8:6: And when forty days had passed, Noah, opening the window of the ark that he had made, released a raven,
verses.8:7: which went out and did not return until the waters were dried up on the earth.
verses.8:8: He also sent out a dove after it, to see whether the waters had already ceased on the face of the earth.
verses.8:9: And when it had not found where its foot might rest, it returned to him into the ark, for the waters were over the whole earth; and he stretched out his hand, took hold of it, and brought it into the ark.
verses.8:10: Then, having waited yet seven other days, he again released the dove from the ark.
verses.8:11: And it came to him toward evening, carrying an olive branch with green leaves in its mouth; therefore Noah understood that the waters had ceased on the earth.
verses.8:12: And nevertheless he waited seven other days, and sent out the dove, which did not return to him anymore.
verses.8:13: Therefore in the six hundred first year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the waters diminished on the earth; and Noah, opening the roof of the ark, looked out and saw that the surface of the earth had dried up.
verses.8:14: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
verses.8:15: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.8:16: "Go out of the ark, you and your wife, your sons and the wives of your sons with you.
verses.8:17: Bring out with you all the living creatures that are with you, of all flesh, both among flying creatures and among beasts and among all crawling creatures that crawl on the earth, and enter upon the earth: increase and multiply upon it."
verses.8:18: So Noah went out, and his sons, his wife, and the wives of his sons with him.
verses.8:19: And also all the living creatures, livestock, and crawling creatures that crawl on the earth went out of the ark according to their kind.
verses.8:20: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord; and taking from all the clean livestock and birds, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.8:21: And the Lord smelled a sweet aroma, and said, "By no means will I curse the earth again because of men, for the perception and thought of the human heart are prone to evil from its youth; therefore I will not again strike every living soul as I have done.
verses.8:22: For all the days of the earth, sowing and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, night and day will not rest."
verses.9:1: Then God blessed Noah and his sons. And He said to them, "Increase and multiply, and fill the earth.
verses.9:2: And let terror and dread of you be upon all the animals of the earth and upon all the birds of the sky, together with everything that moves upon the earth; all the fish of the sea have been delivered into your hand.
verses.9:3: And everything that moves and lives will be food for you; just like green plants, I have delivered all things to you.
verses.9:4: Except that you must not eat flesh with blood.
verses.9:5: For I will require the blood of your lives from the hand of all beasts; and from the hand of man, from the hand of a man and his brother, I will require the life of man.
verses.9:6: Whoever sheds human blood, his blood will be shed, for in the image of God man was made.
verses.9:7: As for you, increase and multiply, and go forth upon the earth, and fill it."
verses.9:8: God also said these things to Noah and to his sons with him:
verses.9:9: "Look, I will establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you,
verses.9:10: and to every living soul that is with you, both among the birds and among the livestock and all the cattle of the earth that came out of the ark, and all the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.9:11: I will establish My covenant with you, and never again will all flesh be killed by the waters of a flood, nor will there be from now on a flood devastating the earth."
verses.9:12: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant that I am giving between Me and you, and to every living soul that is with you, for everlasting generations:
verses.9:13: I will place My bow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.9:14: And when I cover the sky with clouds, My bow will appear in the clouds,
verses.9:15: and I will remember My covenant with you, and with every living soul that animates flesh; and there will no longer be waters of a flood to wipe out all flesh.
verses.9:16: And the bow will be in the clouds, and I will see it, and I will remember the everlasting covenant that has been made between God and every living soul of all flesh that is upon the earth."
verses.9:17: And God said to Noah, "This will be the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and all flesh upon the earth."
verses.9:18: So the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham himself is the father of Canaan.
verses.9:19: These three are the sons of Noah, and from them the entire human race was dispersed over all the earth.
verses.9:20: And Noah, a farmer, began to cultivate the ground, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.9:21: And drinking wine, he became drunk, and was uncovered in his tent.
verses.9:22: When Ham, the father of Canaan, saw this, namely that his father's private parts were uncovered, he reported it to his two brothers outside.
verses.9:23: But Shem and Japheth placed a cloak over their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father's nakedness; and their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father's private parts.
verses.9:24: Now waking from the wine, when Noah learned what his younger son had done to him,
verses.9:25: he said, "Cursed be Canaan; he will be a servant of servants to his brothers."
verses.9:26: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; may Canaan be his servant.
verses.9:27: May God expand Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant."
verses.9:28: Now Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.
verses.9:29: And all his days were completed, nine hundred fifty years, and he died.
verses.10:1: These are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.10:2: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.10:3: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.10:4: Now the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.10:5: From these the islands of the nations were divided in their regions, each one according to his own language and his families in their nations.
verses.10:6: And the sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.10:7: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.10:8: Now Cush fathered Nimrod; he himself began to be powerful on the earth,
verses.10:9: and he was a mighty hunter before the Lord. Because of this came the proverb, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord."
verses.10:10: Now the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.10:11: From that land Asshur went out, and he built Nineveh, and the streets of the city, and Calah,
verses.10:12: and also Resen, between Nineveh and Calah; this is the great city.
verses.10:13: Now Mizraim fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.10:14: Pathrusim, and Casluhim, from whom the Philistines and Caphtorim came out.
verses.10:15: Now Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and the Hittite,
verses.10:16: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
verses.10:17: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
verses.10:18: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite; and after this the peoples of the Canaanites were dispersed.
verses.10:19: And the borders of Canaan were set for those coming from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, until you enter Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.10:20: These are the sons of Ham, in their clans, languages, generations, lands, and nations.
verses.10:21: From Shem also children were born, the father of all the sons of Eber, the older brother of Japheth.
verses.10:22: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.10:23: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.10:24: Now Arpachshad fathered Shelah, from whom Eber was born.
verses.10:25: And to Eber two sons were born: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother was Joktan.
verses.10:26: Now Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.10:29: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.10:30: And their dwelling place was from Mesha, for those going as far as Sephar, the eastern mountain.
verses.10:31: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, and regions in their nations.
verses.10:32: These are the families of Noah according to their peoples and nations. From these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.
verses.11:1: Now the earth had one language and the same words.
verses.11:2: And as they journeyed from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and lived in it.
verses.11:3: And one said to his neighbor, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them with fire." And they had bricks for stones, and bitumen for mortar.
verses.11:4: And they said, "Come, let us make for ourselves a city and a tower whose top may reach to heaven, and let us make our name renowned before we are divided across all lands."
verses.11:5: Now the Lord came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of Adam were building.
verses.11:6: And He said, "Look, there is one people, and one language for all; and they have begun to do this, nor will they desist from their plans until they complete them in deed.
verses.11:7: Come therefore, let Us go down, and let Us confuse their language there, so that no one may hear the voice of his neighbor."
verses.11:8: And so the Lord divided them from that place across all lands, and they stopped building the city.
verses.11:9: And therefore its name was called Babel, because there the language of all the earth was confused, and from there the Lord dispersed them over the face of all regions.
verses.11:10: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the flood.
verses.11:11: And Shem lived five hundred years after he fathered Arpachshad, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:12: Furthermore, Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and fathered Shelah.
verses.11:13: And Arpachshad lived three hundred three years after he fathered Shelah, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:14: Shelah also lived thirty years and fathered Eber.
verses.11:15: And Shelah lived four hundred three years after he fathered Eber, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:16: Now Eber lived thirty-four years and fathered Peleg.
verses.11:17: And Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he fathered Peleg, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:18: Peleg also lived thirty years and fathered Reu.
verses.11:19: And Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he fathered Reu, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:20: Now Reu lived thirty-two years and fathered Serug.
verses.11:21: And Reu lived two hundred seven years after he fathered Serug, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:22: And Serug lived thirty years and fathered Nahor.
verses.11:23: And Serug lived two hundred years after he fathered Nahor, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:24: Now Nahor lived twenty-nine years and fathered Terah.
verses.11:25: And Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he fathered Terah, and he fathered sons and daughters.
verses.11:26: And Terah lived seventy years and fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.11:27: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Moreover, Haran fathered Lot.
verses.11:28: And Haran died before Terah his father, in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
verses.11:29: Now Abram and Nahor took wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.
verses.11:30: Now Sarai was barren and had no children.
verses.11:31: So Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, the son of his son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of Abram his son, and led them out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go into the land of Canaan; and they came as far as Haran and lived there.
verses.11:32: And the days of Terah were two hundred five years, and he died in Haran.
verses.12:1: Now the Lord said to Abram, "Go out from your land, and from your relatives, and from your father's house, and come into the land that I will show you.
verses.12:2: And I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you, and I will magnify your name, and you will be blessed.
verses.12:3: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you, and in you all the families of the earth will be blessed."
verses.12:4: So Abram went out just as the Lord had commanded him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Haran.
verses.12:5: And he took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all the wealth that they possessed, and the souls whom they had made in Haran; and they went out to go into the land of Canaan. And when they had come into it,
verses.12:6: Abram passed through the land as far as the place of Shechem, as far as the illustrious valley. Now the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.12:7: And the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "To your seed I will give this land." And he built there an altar to the Lord, who had appeared to him.
verses.12:8: And moving on from there to the mountain that was on the east of Bethel, he pitched his tent there, having Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; he also built there an altar to the Lord and called upon His name.
verses.12:9: And Abram went on, traveling and advancing further toward the south.
verses.12:10: Now a famine arose in the land, and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there, for the famine had prevailed in the land.
verses.12:11: And when he was near to entering Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, "I know that you are a beautiful woman,
verses.12:12: and that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'She is his wife,' and they will kill me, and spare you.
verses.12:13: Say therefore, I beg you, that you are my sister, so that it may go well with me because of you, and that my soul may live for your sake."
verses.12:14: So when Abram had entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was exceedingly beautiful.
verses.12:15: And the princes reported to Pharaoh and praised her before him, and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.12:16: And they treated Abram well because of her, and he had sheep and oxen and male donkeys, and male servants and female servants, and female donkeys and camels.
verses.12:17: But the Lord scourged Pharaoh and his house with very great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.
verses.12:18: And Pharaoh called Abram and said to him, "What is this that you have done to me? Why did you not disclose that she was your wife?
verses.12:19: For what reason did you say she was your sister, so that I might take her for myself as a wife? Now therefore, here is your wife; take her and go."
verses.12:20: And Pharaoh commanded men concerning Abram, and they escorted him, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.13:1: So Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, toward the southern region.
verses.13:2: Now he was very rich in the possession of gold and silver.
verses.13:3: And he returned by the way by which he had come, from the south to Bethel, as far as the place where he had previously pitched the tent between Bethel and Ai,
verses.13:4: at the place of the altar that he had made previously; and there he called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.13:5: And Lot also, who was with Abram, had flocks of sheep, and herds, and tents.
verses.13:6: Nor could the land hold them so that they might live together, for their wealth was great, and they were not able to live in common.
verses.13:7: Because of this, strife also arose between the herdsmen of the flocks of Abram and Lot. Now at that time the Canaanite and the Perizzite were living in that land.
verses.13:8: So Abram said to Lot, "Please, let there be no dispute between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we are brothers.
verses.13:9: Look, the entire land is before you: withdraw from me, I beg you; if you go to the left, I will hold to the right; if you choose the right, I will proceed to the left."
verses.13:10: So when Lot lifted up his eyes, he saw all the region around the Jordan, which was entirely watered before the Lord overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, like the paradise of the Lord, and like Egypt for those coming to Zoar.
verses.13:11: And Lot chose for himself the region around the Jordan and withdrew from the east; and they were separated each from his brother.
verses.13:12: Abram lived in the land of Canaan; Lot stayed in the towns that were around the Jordan and lived in Sodom.
verses.13:13: Now the men of Sodom were very wicked, and very great sinners before the Lord.
verses.13:14: And the Lord said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you now are, to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west.
verses.13:15: All the land that you see I will give to you and to your seed forever.
verses.13:16: And I will make your seed like the dust of the earth: if any man can count the dust of the earth, he will also be able to count your seed.
verses.13:17: Arise and walk through the land in its length and in its breadth, for I am going to give it to you."
verses.13:18: So Abram, moving his tent, came and lived beside the valley of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar to the Lord.
verses.14:1: Now it happened at that time that Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Pontus, Chedorlaomer king of the Elamites, and Tidal king of the nations
verses.14:2: entered into war against Bera king of Sodom, and against Birsha king of Gomorrah, and against Shinab king of Admah, and against Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and against the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.14:3: All these came together in the Woodland Valley, which is now the Sea of Salt.
verses.14:4: For they had served Chedorlaomer twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they had withdrawn from him.
verses.14:5: Therefore, in the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came, and they struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim with them, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.14:6: and the Horites in the mountains of Seir, as far as the Plains of Paran, which is in the wilderness.
verses.14:7: And they turned back and came to the spring of Mishpat, that is, Kadesh, and they struck all the region of the Amalekites, and the Amorite who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.14:8: And the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and also the king of Bela, which is Zoar, went out, and they drew up a battle line against them in the Woodland Valley,
verses.14:9: namely, against Chedorlaomer king of the Elamites, Tidal king of the nations, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Pontus: four kings against five.
verses.14:10: Now the Woodland Valley had many pits of bitumen. So the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah turned in flight and fell there, and those who remained fled to the mountain.
verses.14:11: And they took all the possessions of Sodom and Gomorrah, and everything that pertains to food, and departed,
verses.14:12: taking also Lot, the son of Abram's brother, who lived in Sodom, and his possessions.
verses.14:13: And look, one who had escaped brought word to Abram the Hebrew, who lived in the valley of Mamre the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and the brother of Aner; for these had made a covenant with Abram.
verses.14:14: When Abram heard this, namely, that his brother Lot had been captured, he counted his equipped household-born servants, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them as far as Dan.
verses.14:15: And having divided his companions, he fell upon them by night, and struck and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is to the left of Damascus.
verses.14:16: And he brought back all the possessions, and his brother Lot with his possessions, the women also, and the people.
verses.14:17: Now the king of Sodom went out to meet him after he had returned from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and of the kings who were with him, in the Valley of Shaveh, which is the King's Valley.
verses.14:18: But Melchizedek king of Salem, bringing out bread and wine (for he was a priest of the Most High God),
verses.14:19: blessed him and said, "Blessed be Abram by the Exalted God, who created heaven and earth,
verses.14:20: and blessed be the Exalted God, under whose protection the enemies are in your hands." And he gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.14:21: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the souls; take the rest for yourself."
verses.14:22: He answered him, "I lift my hand to the Lord, the Exalted God, possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.14:23: that from a thread of the weft to a sandal strap, I will not take anything from all that is yours, so that you may not say, 'I have enriched Abram,'
verses.14:24: except for what the young men have eaten, and the shares of the men who came with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; these will take their shares."
verses.15:1: So after these things had taken place, the word of the Lord came to Abram through a vision, saying, "Do not be afraid, Abram; I am your protector, and your reward is exceedingly great."
verses.15:2: And Abram said, "Lord God, what will You give me? I will go without children, and the son of the steward of my house is this Damascus Eliezer."
verses.15:3: And Abram added, "Yet to me You have not given seed, and look, my household-born servant will be my heir."
verses.15:4: And immediately the word of the Lord came to him, saying, "This one will not be your heir, but he who will come out from your body, him you will have as heir."
verses.15:5: And He led him outside and said to him, "Look up at heaven and count the stars, if you can." And He said to him, "So will your seed be."
verses.15:6: Abram believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
verses.15:7: And He said to him, "I am the Lord who led you out of Ur of the Chaldeans, so that I might give you this land and you might possess it."
verses.15:8: But he said, "Lord God, how can I know that I will possess it?"
verses.15:9: The Lord answered and said, "Take for Me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, and a three-year-old ram, a turtledove also, and a pigeon."
verses.15:10: Taking all these, he divided them through the middle and placed each half opposite the other on either side; but he did not divide the birds.
verses.15:11: And birds descended upon the carcasses, and Abram kept driving them away.
verses.15:12: And as the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram, and a great and dark dread seized him.
verses.15:13: And it was said to him, "Know beforehand for certain that your seed will be a stranger in a land not its own, and they will subject them to servitude and afflict them for four hundred years.
verses.15:14: Yet the nation whom they will serve I will judge, and after these things they will come out with great possessions.
verses.15:15: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace, buried in a good old age.
verses.15:16: And in the fourth generation they will return here, for the iniquities of the Amorites are not yet completed up to the present time."
verses.15:17: So when the sun had gone down, a dark gloom came about, and a smoking furnace appeared, and a torch of fire passing between those divided parts.
verses.15:18: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your seed I will give this land, from the river of Egypt as far as the great river Euphrates,
verses.15:19: the Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.15:20: and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, the Rephaim also,
verses.15:21: and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."
verses.16:1: Now Sarai, the wife of Abram, had not borne children; but having an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar,
verses.16:2: she said to her husband, "Look, the Lord has closed me off so that I should not give birth. Go in to my maidservant; perhaps at least from her I may obtain children." And when he agreed to her pleading,
verses.16:3: she took Hagar the Egyptian, her maidservant, ten years after they had begun to live in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband as a wife.
verses.16:4: And he went in to her. But she, seeing that she had conceived, despised her mistress.
verses.16:5: And Sarai said to Abram, "You are acting unjustly against me! I gave my maidservant into your embrace, and she, seeing that she has conceived, holds me in contempt; may the Lord judge between me and you."
verses.16:6: Abram answered her and said, "Look, your maidservant is in your hand; treat her as you please." So when Sarai afflicted her, she took flight.
verses.16:7: And when the angel of the Lord found her beside a spring of water in the wilderness, which is on the way to Shur in the desert,
verses.16:8: he said to her, "Hagar, maidservant of Sarai, where are you coming from? And where are you going?" She answered, "I am fleeing from the presence of Sarai my mistress."
verses.16:9: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and humble yourself under her hand."
verses.16:10: And again he said, "Multiplying, I will multiply your seed, and it will not be counted because of the multitude."
verses.16:11: And further he said, "Look, you have conceived and will bear a son, and you will call his name Ishmael, because the Lord has heard your affliction.
verses.16:12: This one will be a wild man; his hand will be against all, and the hand of all against him, and opposite all his brothers he will pitch tents."
verses.16:13: Then she called the name of the Lord who was speaking to her, "You are the God who saw me." For she said, "Truly here I have seen the back of Him who sees me."
verses.16:14: Therefore she called that well the Well of Him who lives and sees me. It is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.16:15: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and he called his name Ishmael.
verses.16:16: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
verses.17:1: Now after he had begun to be ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said to him, "I am God Almighty; walk before Me, and be perfect.
verses.17:2: And I will set My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you very greatly."
verses.17:3: Abram fell prostrate on his face.
verses.17:4: And God said to him, "I am, and My covenant is with you, and you will be the father of many nations.
verses.17:5: And your name will no longer be called Abram, but you will be named Abraham, because I have appointed you the father of many nations.
verses.17:6: And I will make you grow exceedingly, and I will set you among the nations, and kings will come forth from you.
verses.17:7: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and between your seed after you throughout their generations, by an everlasting covenant, so that I may be your God and the God of your seed after you.
verses.17:8: And I will give to you and to your seed the land of your sojourning, all the land of Canaan, for an eternal possession, and I will be their God."
verses.17:9: God said again to Abraham, "And you therefore shall keep My covenant, and your seed after you throughout their generations.
verses.17:10: This is My covenant that you shall observe between Me and you, and your seed after you: every male among you shall be circumcised,
verses.17:11: and you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, so that it may be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
verses.17:12: An infant eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations; both the homeborn and the purchased shall be circumcised, and whoever is not of your lineage,
verses.17:13: and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an eternal covenant.
verses.17:14: The male, the flesh of whose foreskin has not been circumcised, that soul shall be wiped out from his people, because he has made My covenant void."
verses.17:15: God also said to Abraham, "As for your wife Sarai, you shall not call her Sarai, but Sarah.
verses.17:16: And I will bless her, and from her I will give you a son whom I am going to bless; and he will become nations, and kings of peoples will arise from him."
verses.17:17: Abraham fell on his face and laughed, saying in his heart, "Do you think a son will be born to a man one hundred years old? And will Sarah, at ninety years old, give birth?"
verses.17:18: And he said to God, "If only Ishmael might live before You!"
verses.17:19: And God said to Abraham, "Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant for him as an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.
verses.17:20: Regarding Ishmael also I have heard you: see, I will bless him, and increase him, and multiply him greatly; he will father twelve leaders, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.17:21: But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time in the next year."
verses.17:22: And when the speech of Him who was speaking with him had ended, God ascended from Abraham.
verses.17:23: Then Abraham took his son Ishmael, and all the homeborn of his household, and all whom he had purchased, all the males among all the men of his household, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin immediately on that very day, just as God had commanded him.
verses.17:24: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.17:25: And his son Ishmael had completed thirteen years at the time of his circumcision.
verses.17:26: On that same day Abraham was circumcised, and his son Ishmael;
verses.17:27: and all the men of his household, both the homeborn and the purchased and the foreigners, were circumcised together.
verses.18:1: Now the Lord appeared to him in the valley of Mamre as he was sitting at the doorway of his tent in the very heat of the day.
verses.18:2: And when he had lifted up his eyes, three men appeared to him standing near him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the doorway of the tent and bowed down on the ground.
verses.18:3: And he said, "Lord, if I have found favor in your eyes, do not pass by your servant;
verses.18:4: but I will bring a little water; and wash your feet, and rest under the tree.
verses.18:5: I will set out a morsel of bread, and strengthen your heart; afterward you will pass on, for this is why you have turned aside to your servant." And they said, "Do as you have spoken."
verses.18:6: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said to her, "Be quick, mix three measures of fine flour, and make loaves baked under the ashes."
verses.18:7: And he himself ran to the herd, and took from there a very tender and choice calf, and gave it to a young servant, who hurried and cooked it.
verses.18:8: He also took butter and milk, and the calf that he had cooked, and set them before them; and he himself stood beside them under the tree.
verses.18:9: And when they had eaten, they said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" He answered, "Look, she is in the tent."
verses.18:10: And He said to him, "Returning, I will come to you at this time, with life as companion, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Upon hearing this, Sarah laughed behind the doorway of the tent.
verses.18:11: Now both were old, and of advanced age, and the way of women had ceased to occur for Sarah.
verses.18:12: And she laughed secretly, saying, "After I have grown old, and my lord is an old man, shall I give myself to pleasure?"
verses.18:13: Now the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, 'Am I really going to give birth as an old woman?'
verses.18:14: Is anything difficult for God? According to what was appointed, I will return to you at this same time, with life as companion, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.18:15: Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," terrified with fear. But the Lord said, "It is not so; rather, you did laugh."
verses.18:16: Then when the men had risen from there, they directed their eyes toward Sodom; and Abraham walked along with them, escorting them.
verses.18:17: And the Lord said, "Shall I be able to hide from Abraham the things that I am about to do,
verses.18:18: since he is to become a great and most mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth are to be blessed in him?
verses.18:19: For I know that he will command his sons and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord and to do justice and righteousness, so that the Lord may bring about for Abraham's sake all the things that He has spoken to him."
verses.18:20: Therefore the Lord said, "The outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah has been multiplied, and their sin has become exceedingly grave.
verses.18:21: I will go down and see whether they have fulfilled in deed the outcry that has come to Me, or whether it is not so, that I may know."
verses.18:22: And they turned from there and went away to Sodom; but Abraham was still standing before the Lord.
verses.18:23: And drawing near, he said, "Will You really destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.18:24: If there are fifty righteous people in the city, will they perish together? And will You not spare that place for the sake of the fifty righteous people, if they are in it?
verses.18:25: Far be it from You to do this thing, and kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous becomes like the wicked; this is not like You: You who judge all the earth will by no means execute this judgment."
verses.18:26: And the Lord said to him, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous people in the midst of the city, I will pardon the whole place for their sake."
verses.18:27: Answering, Abraham said, "Since I have once begun, I will speak to my Lord, though I am dust and ashes.
verses.18:28: What if there are five fewer than fifty righteous people? Will You wipe out the entire city because of forty-five?" And He said, "I will not wipe it out if I find forty-five there."
verses.18:29: And again he spoke to Him, "But if forty are found there, what will You do?" He said, "I will not strike it for the sake of forty."
verses.18:30: "Please do not be indignant, Lord," he said, "if I speak: what if thirty are found there?" He answered, "I will not do it if I find thirty there."
verses.18:31: "Since I have once begun," he said, "I will speak to my Lord: what if twenty are found there?" He said, "I will not kill them for the sake of twenty."
verses.18:32: "I implore You," he said, "do not be angry, Lord, if I speak just once more: what if ten are found there?" He said, "I will not wipe it out for the sake of ten."
verses.18:33: The Lord departed after He ceased speaking to Abraham, and he returned to his place.
verses.19:1: And the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, while Lot was sitting at the gates of the city. When he saw them, he got up and went to meet them, and bowed down prostrate on the ground,
verses.19:2: and said, "I beg you, my lords, turn aside into the house of your servant and stay there; wash your feet, and in the morning set out on your way." They said, "No; instead, we will stay in the square."
verses.19:3: He pressed them very strongly to turn in with him; and when they had entered his house, he prepared a feast, baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
verses.19:4: But before they went to lie down, the men of the city surrounded the house, from boy to old man, all the people together.
verses.19:5: And they called to Lot and said to him, "Where are the men who came in to you in the night? Bring them out here, so that we may know them."
verses.19:6: Lot went out to them, shutting the door behind him, and said,
verses.19:7: "Please, my brothers, do not, do not do this evil.
verses.19:8: I have two daughters who have not yet known a man; I will bring them out to you, and abuse them as it pleases you, provided only that you do no evil to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof."
verses.19:9: But they said, "Step back over there." And again, "You came in," they said, "as a foreigner; surely not to judge? Therefore we will afflict you yourself more than these men." And they pressed against Lot most violently, and were already close to breaking down the doors.
verses.19:10: And look, the men reached out their hands and brought Lot inside to themselves, and shut the door,
verses.19:11: and they struck those who were outside with blindness, from the smallest to the greatest, so that they could not find the door.
verses.19:12: Now they said to Lot, "Do you have anyone of your own here? Son-in-law, or sons, or daughters, all who belong to you, bring them out of this city;
verses.19:13: for we will wipe out this place, because their outcry has grown great before the Lord, who sent us to destroy them."
verses.19:14: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were about to marry his daughters, and said, "Get up, go out from this place, because the Lord will wipe out this city." And he seemed to them to be speaking as if joking.
verses.19:15: And when it was morning, the angels pressed him, saying, "Get up, take your wife and the two daughters whom you have, so that you do not likewise perish in the wickedness of the city."
verses.19:16: While he hesitated, they took hold of his hand, and the hand of his wife, and of his two daughters, because the Lord was sparing him.
verses.19:17: And they brought him out and set him outside the city. And there they spoke to him, saying, "Save your life; do not look behind you, nor stop in all the surrounding region, but save yourself on the mountain, so that you also do not perish at the same time."
verses.19:18: And Lot said to them, "Please, my lord,
verses.19:19: since your servant has found favor before you, and you have magnified your mercy which you have shown to me to save my life, yet I cannot be saved on the mountain, for fear that disaster may overtake me and I die;
verses.19:20: there is this city nearby to which I can flee, a small one, and I will be saved in it; is it not a little one, and my soul will live?"
verses.19:21: And he said to him, "Look, even in this I have accepted your prayers, so that I will not overthrow the city for which you have spoken.
verses.19:22: Hurry, and be saved there, because I will not be able to do anything until you enter there." For that reason, the name of that city was called Zoar.
verses.19:23: The sun rose over the earth, and Lot entered Zoar.
verses.19:24: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the Lord out of heaven,
verses.19:25: and overthrew these cities and all the surrounding region, all the inhabitants of the cities, and all the green things of the earth.
verses.19:26: And as his wife looked back behind her, she was turned into a statue of salt.
verses.19:27: Now Abraham, rising in the morning where he had previously stood with the Lord,
verses.19:28: gazed out over Sodom and Gomorrah and the entire land of that region, and he saw ashes rising from the earth like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.19:29: For when God overthrew the cities of that region, remembering Abraham, He delivered Lot from the overthrow of the cities in which he had lived.
verses.19:30: And Lot went up from Zoar and stayed on the mountain, and his two daughters also with him (for he had been afraid to stay in Zoar), and he stayed in a cave, he and his two daughters with him.
verses.19:31: And the older said to the younger, "Our father is old, and none of the men has remained on the earth who could come in to us according to the custom of the whole earth.
verses.19:32: Come, let us make him drunk with wine, and let us sleep with him, so that we may preserve seed from our father."
verses.19:33: So they gave their father wine to drink that night. And the older went in and slept with her father; but he did not notice either when his daughter lay down or when she got up.
verses.19:34: On the next day also, the older said to the younger, "Look, yesterday I slept with my father; let us give him wine to drink this night also, and you will sleep with him, so that we may save seed from our father."
verses.19:35: On that night as well they gave their father wine to drink, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; and not even then did he notice when she lay with him or when she got up.
verses.19:36: So the two daughters of Lot conceived by their father.
verses.19:37: And the older gave birth to a son and called his name Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to the present day.
verses.19:38: The younger also gave birth to a son and called his name Ammon, that is, "Son of my people"; he is the father of the Ammonites to this day.
verses.20:1: Abraham set out from there into the southern land, lived between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.20:2: And he said of Sarah his wife, "She is my sister." So Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent and took her.
verses.20:3: But God came to Abimelech through a dream in the night and said to him, "Look, you will die because of the woman whom you have taken, for she has a husband."
verses.20:4: Now Abimelech had not touched her, and he said, "Lord, will You kill an unknowing and righteous nation?
verses.20:5: Did he not himself say to me, 'She is my sister,' and she herself said, 'He is my brother'? In the sincerity of my heart and the cleanness of my hands I have done this."
verses.20:6: And God said to him, "I also know that you have done this with a sincere heart, and therefore I kept you from sinning against Me, and I did not allow you to touch her.
verses.20:7: Now therefore, return the wife to her husband, because he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live; but if you are unwilling to return her, know that you will certainly die, you and all that is yours."
verses.20:8: And immediately rising in the night, Abimelech called all his servants and spoke all these words in their ears, and all the men were greatly afraid.
verses.20:9: Then Abimelech called Abraham also and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have we sinned against you, that you have brought a great sin upon me and upon my kingdom? You have done to us things you should not have done."
verses.20:10: And protesting again, he said, "What did you see, that you did this?"
verses.20:11: Abraham answered, "I thought to myself, saying, 'Perhaps there is no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.'
verses.20:12: Besides, she is truly my sister as well, the daughter of my father and not the daughter of my mother, and I took her as my wife.
verses.20:13: Now after God brought me out from my father's house, I said to her, 'You will show this mercy to me: in every place that we enter, you will say that I am your brother.'"
verses.20:14: So Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and returned Sarah his wife to him,
verses.20:15: and said, "The land is before you; live wherever it pleases you."
verses.20:16: And to Sarah he said, "Look, I have given a thousand pieces of silver to your brother; this will be for you a covering of the eyes before all who are with you and wherever you go; and remember that you were caught."
verses.20:17: Then as Abraham prayed, God healed Abimelech and his wife and his female servants, and they gave birth;
verses.20:18: for the Lord had closed up every womb of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, the wife of Abraham.
verses.21:1: Now the Lord visited Sarah, just as He had promised, and He fulfilled the things He had spoken.
verses.21:2: And she conceived and gave birth to a son in her old age, at the time God had foretold to her.
verses.21:3: And Abraham called the name of his son, whom Sarah had borne to him, Isaac;
verses.21:4: and he circumcised him on the eighth day, just as God had commanded him,
verses.21:5: when he was one hundred years old; for at this age of his father, Isaac was born.
verses.21:6: And Sarah said, "God has made laughter for me; whoever hears will laugh with me."
verses.21:7: And again she said, "Who, upon hearing it, would have believed Abraham that Sarah was nursing a son, whom she bore to him when he was already old?"
verses.21:8: So the boy grew and was weaned; and Abraham made a great banquet on the day of his weaning.
verses.21:9: And when Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian playing with Isaac, her son, she said to Abraham,
verses.21:10: "Drive out this servant woman and her son, for the son of the servant woman will not be an heir with my son Isaac."
verses.21:11: Abraham took this hard on account of his son.
verses.21:12: God said to him, "Do not let it seem harsh to you concerning the boy and concerning your servant woman; in all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice, because in Isaac your seed will be called.
verses.21:13: But I will also make the son of the servant woman into a great nation, because he is your seed."
verses.21:14: So Abraham rose early in the morning, and taking bread and a skin of water, he placed them on her shoulder, handed over the boy, and sent her away. When she had departed, she wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.21:15: And when the water in the skin was used up, she cast the boy down beneath one of the trees that were there.
verses.21:16: And she went away and sat down opposite, as far off as a bow can shoot; for she said, "I will not watch the boy dying." And sitting opposite, she lifted up her voice and wept.
verses.21:17: Now God heard the voice of the boy; and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, saying, "What are you doing, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy from the place where he is.
verses.21:18: Rise, take up the boy, and hold his hand, because I will make him into a great nation."
verses.21:19: And God opened her eyes; and seeing a well of water, she went and filled the skin, and gave the boy a drink.
verses.21:20: And He was with him; and he grew, and stayed in the wilderness, and became a young archer.
verses.21:21: And he lived in the desert of Paran, and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.21:22: At that same time Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything that you do.
verses.21:23: Swear therefore by God that you will not harm me, my descendants, or my lineage; rather, according to the mercy that I have done for you, you will do for me and for the land in which you have lived as a stranger."
verses.21:25: And he rebuked Abimelech because of a well of water that his servants had taken away by force.
verses.21:26: Abimelech answered, "I did not know who did this thing; besides, you did not inform me, and I have not heard of it except today."
verses.21:27: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech; and both of them struck a covenant.
verses.21:28: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart.
verses.21:29: Abimelech said to him, "What do these seven ewe lambs mean, which you have made stand apart?"
verses.21:30: But he said, "You will accept seven ewe lambs from my hand, so that they may be a witness for me that I dug this well."
verses.21:31: Therefore that place was called Beersheba, because there both of them swore.
verses.21:32: And they entered into a covenant for the well of the oath.
verses.21:33: Now Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his forces, rose and returned to the land of the Philistines. But Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord, the eternal God.
verses.21:34: And he was a resident of the land of the Philistines for many days.
verses.22:1: After these things had taken place, God tested Abraham and said to him, "Abraham, Abraham." He answered, "Here I am."
verses.22:2: He said to him, "Take your only-begotten son, whom you love, Isaac, and go into the land of vision, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains that I will show you."
verses.22:3: So Abraham, rising in the night, saddled his donkey, taking with him two young men and Isaac his son; and when he had cut wood for the burnt offering, he went to the place that God had commanded him.
verses.22:4: Now on the third day, lifting up his eyes, he saw the place far off,
verses.22:5: and he said to his young men, "Wait here with the donkey; I and the boy will hurry all the way over there, and after we have worshiped, we will return to you."
verses.22:6: He also took the wood of the burnt offering and placed it on Isaac his son, while he himself carried the fire and the sword in his hands. And as the two went on together,
verses.22:7: Isaac said to his father, "My father." And he answered, "What do you want, son?" "Look," he said, "the fire and the wood; where is the victim of the burnt offering?"
verses.22:8: Abraham said, "God will provide for Himself the victim of the burnt offering, my son." So they went on together.
verses.22:9: And they came to the place that God had shown him, where he built an altar and arranged the wood on top; and when he had bound Isaac his son, he laid him on the altar upon the pile of wood.
verses.22:10: And he stretched out his hand and seized the sword to sacrifice his son.
verses.22:11: And look, the angel of the Lord called out from heaven, saying, "Abraham, Abraham!" And he answered, "Here I am."
verses.22:12: And he said to him, "Do not stretch out your hand against the boy, nor do anything to him; now I know that you fear God and have not spared your only-begotten son because of Me."
verses.22:13: Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw behind his back a ram caught by its horns among the briers; and taking it, he offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
verses.22:14: And he called the name of that place "The Lord sees." For this reason it is said to this day, "On the mountain the Lord will see."
verses.22:15: Now the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven, saying,
verses.22:16: "By Myself I have sworn, says the Lord: because you have done this thing and have not spared your only-begotten son because of Me,
verses.22:17: I will bless you and multiply your seed like the stars of heaven and like the sand that is on the seashore; your seed will possess the gates of their enemies,
verses.22:18: and in your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."
verses.22:19: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Beersheba together, and he lived there.
verses.22:20: So after these things had taken place, it was reported to Abraham that Milcah also had borne sons to Nahor his brother:
verses.22:21: Uz the firstborn, and Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of the Syrians,
verses.22:22: and Chesed and Hazo, also Pildash and Jidlaph,
verses.22:23: and Bethuel, from whom Rebekah was born. Milcah bore these eight to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.22:24: And his concubine, named Reumah, gave birth to Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.23:1: Now Sarah lived for one hundred twenty-seven years.
verses.23:2: And she died in the city of Arba, which is Hebron, in the land of Canaan; and Abraham came to lament and weep for her.
verses.23:3: And when he had risen from the funeral rites, he spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.23:4: "I am a foreigner and a sojourner among you; give me the right of a burial place with you, so that I may bury my dead."
verses.23:5: The sons of Heth answered, saying,
verses.23:6: "Listen to us, lord: you are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in our choicest burial places, and no one will be able to prevent you from burying your dead in his tomb."
verses.23:7: Abraham rose and bowed down to the people of the land, namely, the sons of Heth.
verses.23:8: And he said to them, "If it pleases your soul that I bury my dead, listen to me and intercede for me with Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.23:9: so that he may give me the double cave which he has at the farthest part of his field; for a fair sum of money let him hand it over to me in your presence as a possession for a burial place."
verses.23:10: Now Ephron was living in the midst of the sons of Heth. And Ephron answered Abraham in the hearing of all who entered the gate of that city, saying,
verses.23:11: "By no means let it be so, my lord, but rather, you listen closely to what I am saying. I hand over the field to you, and the cave that is in it, in the presence of the sons of my people; bury your dead."
verses.23:12: Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
verses.23:13: And he spoke to Ephron with the people standing around: "I ask that you listen to me. I will give money for the field; accept it, and so I will bury my dead in it."
verses.23:15: "My lord, listen to me: the land that you ask for is worth four hundred shekels of silver; that is the price between me and you, but how much is this? Bury your dead."
verses.23:16: When Abraham had heard this, he weighed out the money that Ephron had asked for, in the hearing of the sons of Heth: four hundred shekels of silver, of approved public currency.
verses.23:17: And the field that was formerly Ephron's, in which was the double cave, facing Mamre—both the field itself and the cave, and all its trees within all the borders all around—was confirmed
verses.23:18: to Abraham as a possession, in the sight of the sons of Heth and of all who entered the gate of that city.
verses.23:19: And so Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the double cave of the field, which faced Mamre. This is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
verses.23:20: And the field, and the cavern that was in it, were confirmed to Abraham as a possession for a tomb by the sons of Heth.
verses.24:1: Now Abraham was old and of many days, and the Lord had blessed him in everything.
